tasks.setup: deno run -A scripts/godot.ts setup && deno task setup:stubs
tasks.dev: deno task import && deno run -A scripts/godot.ts -- --path .
tasks.kit: deno task import && deno run -A scripts/godot.ts -- --path . res://app/kit_viewer.tscn
tasks.lint: uvx --from gdtoolkit==4.5.0 gdlint core app tests
tasks.fmt: uvx --from gdtoolkit==4.5.0 gdformat core app tests
tasks.fmt:check: uvx --from gdtoolkit==4.5.0 gdformat --check core app tests
tasks.build: deno task import && deno run -A scripts/build.ts
tasks.ci: deno check scripts && deno task boundary && deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task import && deno task test && deno task build
